idf_component_register(
    SRCS "rr_game.c" "rr_content.c" "rr_iso.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
    REQUIRES m5stack_tab5 esp_hw_support
    EMBED_FILES "assets/rr_tiles.bin"
)
# m5stack_tab5 pulls in lvgl + the BSP (bsp/esp-bsp.h); esp_hw_support provides
# esp_random.h for the skill-check dice. The isometric sprite atlas
# (assets/rr_tiles.bin, generated by tools/gen_tiles.py) is embedded in flash and
# blitted directly — no runtime image decoder.
